text: MKUltra was officially authorized by CIA Director Allen Dulles in April 1953.

text: Its stated goal was the development of techniques for "behavior modification" — a clinical way of saying they wanted to learn how to control what people believed, what they said, and what they did.

text: The program eventually involved 150 separate research projects. It funded experiments at 80 institutions, including 44 colleges and universities, 15 research foundations, and 12 hospitals.
